claim.why_it_matters: These are subclauses of 6.3.1.1 Relation Condition, which the transcription heads at level 4 (`#### 6.3.1.1 Relation Condition`), yet they are headed at level 3 (`###`), the same level as `### 6.3.1 Simple Conditions`. The heading tree makes them siblings of 6.3.1 rather than children of 6.3.1.1, so any tool that slices the document by heading hierarchy detaches them from the Relation Condition clause.
